name: MLP with Positional Encoding and IOR Activation
aliases: MLP with Skip Connections and Refractive Index Activation
definition: A multi-layer perceptron that maps 3D coordinates to a scalar field (e.g., refractive index or emission) using positional encoding, residual skip connections, and a domain-specific activation function to constrain output ranges.
summary: An MLP mapping 3D coordinates to refractive index fields using positional encoding and skip connections, distinguished by an IOR activation ensuring physically valid outputs greater than one.
